title: Travis Taylor arrives as a skeptic
summary: Breaks Silence tells of Travis Taylor arrives as a skeptic, about season 1 at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and a team member. I mean when Dr. Taylor flew out to the ranch with me for the first time, he was an absolute skeptic.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah where people report strange happenings, says a scientist named Dr. Travis Taylor flew out to the ranch with him for the first time as "an absolute skeptic". He tells it on Jesse Michels's podcast to show that even a doubter on his team started out unconvinced, which would make what Taylor later saw there count for more.
